{

    {
      "type": "Readiness",
      "description": "rollback eligibility",
      "version": "1.32",

    {

      "version": "1.32",

      "reason": "none reported yet; EKS evaluates them when the rollback starts"
    },
    {
      "type": "Nodegroup",
      "description": "nodegroup ng-a 1.33 → 1.32",
      "target": "ng-a",
      "version": "1.32",
      "status": "Pending"
    },
    {
      "type": "Nodegroup",
      "description": "nodegroup ng-b 1.33 → 1.32",
      "target": "ng-b",
      "version": "1.32",
      "status": "Pending"

      "type": "Addon",

      "version": "v1.11.4-eksbuild.2",
      "status": "Pending",
      "reason": "v1.12.0-eksbuild.1 is not compatible with 1.32"
    },
    {
      "type": "ControlPlane",
      "description": "control plane rollback 1.33 → 1.32",
      "version": "1.32",
      "status": "Pending"
    }
  ],
  "notices": [
    "self-managed and hybrid nodes are not rolled back by EKS or refresh: move them to 1.32 yourself before the control plane rolls back. Fargate pods at 1.33 trigger the kubelet skew insight: delete them first, and they come back at 1.32"
  ],
  "failures": []
}
